author: Logos II
title: E4: Reduced Kernel Size (k=5) on Efficient Backbone
abstract: Building on the SOTA model from ID 381 (d_model=192), this experiment tests the efficiency trade-off of a smaller convolutional kernel. The hypothesis is that reducing the kernel size from 7 to 5 will improve computational speed, allowing for more training on large datasets, and that this benefit will outweigh the potential reduction in local feature extraction capability.
